universe.name: Acrylic Alleyways
universe.why: A neon-drenched, frosted acrylic and circuit board miniature city perfectly captures the 'red-light district' vibe of the internet, making it look like a physical, glowing cyber-neighborhood without being explicit.
universe.pacing: Pulsing, rhythmic, escalating like a flashing neon sign.
universe.signature_shot: The penguin in a tweed jacket proudly guarding a locked, glowing red, but entirely empty acrylic box.
universe.look_bible: Miniature neon cyberpunk city made of frosted acrylic, glowing fiber optic cables, and brass circuit traces. Dark ambient lighting pierced by intense neon pink, cyan, and deep red LED glows. Macro lens with shallow depth of field, rich bokeh. Smooth glossy plastic, frosted glass, and metallic mesh textures.
universe.penguin_render: Rendered natively as a glossy, bottom-heavy vinyl art toy with big round white eye-rings, bright orange feet, and glowing fiber-optic tufts on its head instead of feathers.
universe.music: Clean synth pulses with rhythmic, echoing electronic beats and a subtle cyberpunk bassline.

penguin.arc: The penguin wants to protect its respectable university but ends up proudly guarding an empty box.

shots.motion: Camera pulls back slightly as the red blocks drop and lock into the switchboard.
Camera tracks smoothly along the brass circuit trace following the bright pulse of red light.
Camera pushes in closer as the red light hits the frosted glass gate, illuminating it from behind.
Camera tilts down slightly as a heavy, opaque brass shutter violently slams down over the gate.
Camera pulls back slightly as a barrage of angry orange frosted glass envelopes begins to rain down rapidly.
Camera slowly orbits slightly as a heavy, deep blue glass envelope lands and crushes the overflowing pile.
Camera pushes in slowly as a bright green laser grid activates and scans over the dark acrylic bin.
Camera tracks right slightly as the laser dissolves the envelopes, revealing a shining red glass pedestal.
Camera tilts up from the red pedestal to show the glowing red neon gate swinging wide open.
Camera pushes forward steadily as a thick, opaque grey glass wall rapidly rises up from the floor.
Camera tilts down slightly as the grey glass wall completely encloses the red alleyway, trapping the light.
Camera pans slightly as the penguin hastily slaps a heavy brass padlock onto the empty red acrylic box.
Camera pulls back and up as the penguin stands guard and a glowing pulse of cyan data cleanly bypasses the box.
Camera continues pulling back, revealing numerous locked, empty red boxes scattered among the bright cyan buildings.
Camera slowly drifts up for a final sweeping wide view of the vast acrylic city, showing the isolated grey box.
